description: This script provides functions for extracting, patching, and validating calibration data from various hardware storage mediums and files, specifically for use with OpenWrt firmware. It includes functions for handling MTD devices, UBI volumes, MMC partitions, and sysfs interfaces, as well as patching MAC addresses and regdomains in firmware data.

methods.name: caldata_dd
methods.description: Performs a dd operation from source to target with specified block size, offset, and count.

methods.name: caldata_die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: caldata_extract
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from a partition or device.

methods.name: caldata_extract_ubi
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from a UBI volume.

methods.name: caldata_extract_mmc
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from an MMC partition.

methods.name: caldata_extract_reverse
methods.description: Extracts calibration data in reverse byte order.

methods.name: caldata_from_file
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from a file source.

methods.name: caldata_sysfsload_from_file
methods.description: Loads calibration data into sysfs from a file.

methods.name: caldata_valid
methods.description: Validates calibration data by checking magic number.

methods.name: caldata_patch_data
methods.description: Patches calibration data and checksum in firmware files.

methods.name: ath9k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches MAC address in firmware data.

methods.name: ath9k_patch_mac_crc
methods.description: Patches MAC address and CRC in firmware data.

methods.name: ath10k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches MAC address for ath10k devices.

methods.name: ath11k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches MAC address for ath11k devices with specific ID.

methods.name: ath10k_remove_regdomain
methods.description: Removes regulatory domain info from firmware.

methods.name: ath11k_remove_regdomain
methods.description: Removes regulatory domain info from firmware for ath11k.

methods.name: ath11k_set_macflag
methods.description: Sets MAC flag in firmware data.
